authorization: Maintainer explicitly requested using both machines at full available concurrency.
scope: All 1728 SGNS and 84 LLM primary-budget reference requests. Preserve every family, selected winner, raw/native baseline, original query trace and repetition count.
execution: Eight concurrent fixed-core lanes on the original CPU measurement host. Each lane executes one fresh single-thread process at a time, on the same assigned physical core as that model's main measurements. Start only after that phase's complete main grid and all local GPU work finish. When the CPU phase-overlap plan is present, the complete LLM CPU main grid must also finish before either reference phase, preventing concurrent use of the same core.
provenance: Record reference execution mode, worker count, source hash, plan hash, core affinity, local GPU gate and all original output hashes. Legacy serial-reference paths identify the request group, not exclusive execution. Preserve legacy dispatch controllers separately.
claim: Independent complete reference queries under concurrent fixed-core load. Memory bandwidth remains shared. These references do not support a host-exclusive CPU latency claim; report their actual execution mode in figures and summaries.
